**Orbweaver 1.0.5 is the desktop side of Orbweaver Mobile: pair an iPhone, then answer prompts, watch and chat into sessions, and start new ones from your phone.** It also fixes a stall in the link between two Macs.

## What's new

- **Pair a phone.** **Pair phone…** in the tray menu and **Settings → Paired phones** show a QR code for the Orbweaver Mobile app. Everything between the desktop and the phone is end-to-end encrypted. The relay in the middle forwards sealed frames and can't read them. Keys live in the macOS Keychain, or are protected with DPAPI on Windows. You can remove a phone from either end. The iPhone app is in private testing and isn't available to everyone yet.
- **Answer prompts from the phone.** When a session stops at a permission dialog, your paired phones get a notification. Approve or deny it with Face ID. Before pressing anything, the desktop checks the screen still shows the same dialog, and refuses if it changed. It presses exactly one key, without bringing the window forward. This works in tmux, iTerm2, Terminal.app, WezTerm, kitty and Windows console windows (Windows Terminal included), for Claude Code, Codex and Grok. An "always allow" option whose scope doesn't fit on screen is never offered.
- **Answer questions from the phone.** Claude Code's question forms (AskUserQuestion) reach the phone as questions you can answer: single choice, multi-select, and a typed "Other" answer. Before, the session showed as waiting with nothing on the phone to answer.
- **Watch, chat into and start sessions from the phone.** The phone can stream a session's transcript live, type into it, and start a new Claude Code, Codex or Grok session on this machine, under a named account if you like. It also shows each account's usage and tells you when a session finishes or hits a limit.
- **A Live Activity of your sessions.** The desktop sends the phone a short summary of how many sessions are waiting, working and idle, for the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island.
- **Approve from your Apple Watch.** A phone can register a Watch key with the desktop. That key can only approve or deny a prompt, nothing more.
- **Persona pictures on the phone.** Sessions, notifications and the phone's Personas screen show each session's persona and picture.

## What's fixed

- **The link between two Macs no longer wedges when both send a persona picture at once.** Each side was waiting for the other to read a large picture before it would read anything itself, so neither did, while both still showed as connected. Messages are now read as they arrive, whatever is being sent.

## Upgrading

- Install 1.0.5 from the update notice, or by hand as usual.
- **macOS:** if your other machines, OpenClaw or the phone relay stop connecting after the upgrade, re-grant Local Network in **System Settings → Privacy & Security**.

## Known limitations

- The iPhone app isn't publicly available yet, so the phone features above need a test build.
- On iTerm2, Terminal.app, kitty, WezTerm and Windows console windows, the guard on typing from another machine's chat panel still goes only by whether the session says it is waiting for you. Sessions in tmux get the full screen check.

## Which file do I want

| Platform | Download |
| --- | --- |
| macOS, Apple silicon (M1 and later) | `Orbweaver-1.0.5-osx-arm64.dmg` |
| macOS, Intel | `Orbweaver-1.0.5-osx-x64.dmg` |
| Windows 10/11, 64-bit | `Orbweaver-1.0.5-win-x64-setup.exe` |

The `OrbweaverSpeech-*.zip` files are the optional neural speech engine. The app downloads the one it needs, so you don't need to.
